description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-proofs/school-kinds (#4707) at a
Träger with two schools: the Träger's schools, the binding of the Träger
transaction, its release and the mappings in one statement each; then per
school the binding of its tenant transaction and its kinds in one statement
(ADR 0105: no transaction carries Träger and school). Flat in the number of
kinds.
